title: Job-Application Eligibility Criteria and Screening Timeline
content: All job applications submitted on the Naukri platform must satisfy baseline eligibility criteria including recognized university degrees and verified functional experience benchmarks. Applications undergo initial screening within 3 to 5 business days by the assigned talent acquisition team. Profiles meeting all eligibility criteria transition to Screening status, while applications unreviewed after 14 business days are escalated to the recruitment lead.

title: Internal-Transfer Eligibility and Career Mobility Policy
content: Current employees are eligible to apply for internal job transfers across functional departments after completing a minimum tenure of 12 months in their present role. Applicants must hold a consistent performance rating of at least 3.5 out of 5 and receive written endorsement from their direct manager. Candidates seeking internal lateral transfers undergo an expedited interview cycle with the destination department head.

title: Interview Scheduling, Rescheduling, and Cancellation Process
content: The interview-scheduling process allows candidates to select preferred interview time slots directly through the Naukri candidate portal upon receipt of an invitation. Candidates may request an interview reschedule up to 24 hours prior to the confirmed slot, with a maximum of two reschedules permitted per application lifecycle. Cancellations made with less than 4 hours notice without an approved emergency reason will result in automatic application rejection.

title: Probation-Period Policy and Performance Confirmation Guidelines
content: All newly hired candidates are subject to a standard probation period of 6 months commencing on their official joining date. Formal performance reviews are conducted during the fifth month of probation to assess objective key results and cultural integration. Upon successful completion of the review, candidates receive written confirmation of regular employment, while unsatisfactory evaluations may result in a one-time probation extension of up to 3 months.

title: Offer-Negotiation Policy and Compensation Bands
content: The offer-negotiation policy establishes standard compensation bands determined by job category, seniority level, and industry percentiles. Candidates may initiate salary negotiations within a 15% range above the initial offer figure by providing verified competing written offers or exceptional assessment scores. Annual compensation packages will not exceed the maximum band threshold of INR 3,000,000 without formal executive compensation board approval.

title: Remote-Work Eligibility and Hybrid Workplace Guidelines
content: Eligibility for remote work and hybrid working arrangements is determined by role designation, business requirements, and operational feasibility. Candidates hired for eligible roles may work remotely up to three days per week after completing their initial 90-day onboarding period. Remote-work authorization requires high-speed broadband connectivity, adherence to data protection standards, and quarterly performance reviews.

title: Background-Verification Process and Criminal Records Check
content: All employment offers remain strictly conditional upon successful completion of a comprehensive background-verification process conducted by an accredited third-party agency. The verification audits past 7 years of employment records, educational degree credentials, and criminal database registers. Any falsification of credentials or adverse criminal findings will result in immediate offer rescission and disqualification from future consideration.

title: Notice-Period Policy and Buyout Guidelines
content: Candidates must declare their existing employment notice-period obligations during final interview rounds, with standard expected joining dates scheduled within 30 to 60 calendar days. Notice-period buyout assistance of up to 30 days basic salary may be approved for critical technical and management roles upon business unit authorization. Joining dates may be deferred by up to 30 additional days only if written notice is submitted at least two weeks prior to the scheduled date.

title: Employee Referral-Bonus Policy and Payout Structure
content: The employee referral-bonus policy rewards staff who refer qualified candidates successfully hired through the Naukri portal. Referral bonuses are structured at INR 25,000 for standard individual contributor roles and INR 50,000 for critical or leadership positions. Bonus payouts are disbursed in the referral sponsor's payroll cycle following the referred employee's successful completion of 90 days of active service.

title: Exit-Interview Process, Offboarding, and Rehire Cooling-Off Period
content: The exit-interview process requires all departing employees to complete an offboarding questionnaire and participate in a confidential 45-minute discussion with human resources during their final working week. Insights gathered during exit interviews are documented to identify workplace improvements and organizational attrition factors. Candidates who leave or are rejected after interviews remain subject to a 6-month cooling-off period before reapplying for the identical position.

title: Diversity-Hiring Guidelines and Equal Opportunity Framework
content: Naukri diversity-hiring guidelines mandate that all candidate talent pipelines and shortlists include balanced representation across gender, veteran status, and historically underrepresented groups. Hiring panels must comprise diverse evaluators to mitigate unconscious bias and ensure meritocratic evaluation rubrics. The organization enforces zero tolerance for discriminatory practices and audits hiring metrics quarterly to advance inclusive workplace representation.

title: Applicant-Data-Retention Policy and Candidate Privacy Protection
content: The applicant-data-retention policy governs the lawful storage, encryption, and lifecycle management of all candidate resumes and application records submitted to the platform. Personal identifiable information and application histories are securely retained for a maximum duration of 24 months from the application date before undergoing automated permanent purging. Candidates may exercise their statutory data privacy rights at any time to request immediate deletion of their personal profile data.
